description_en: Queries the collection status of each device under a task
description_zh: 查询任务下每台设备的采集状态
kebab_example: aliyun emas-appmonitor get-tlog-task-collections --app-key 24780725 --os android --task-id WXAIGC5ZCVUIYY78ABTCOUHGSQ --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTlogTaskCollections

parameters.help_en:
The OS type. Valid values:
iphoneos: iOS
android: Android
parameters.help_zh:
os类型
iphoneos(苹果)
android(安卓)
parameters.name: os

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This is the primary code, typically a network or non-business error
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误Code，主Code，一般为网络或非业务错误

Model.description_en:
Model Object: The business data object returned by the operation.
Model.collectionNums Long: The total number of collection records under the current task.
Model.collectionsList Array: The list of collection results grouped by collection status.
Model.collectionsList[].name String: The name of the collection status group, which typically corresponds to the status of the collection record, such as FINISHED.
Model.collectionsList[].list Array: The list of collection records under the current status group.

Description of `Model.collectionsList[].list[]` fields:

reason Object: The information about the reason for initiating the task.
reason.description String: The description of the reason, such as logs from recent days calculated based on the initiation time.
reason.type String: The type of the reason, such as USER, which indicates that the task was initiated by a user.
appVersion String: The application version number.
os String: The device OS type. Valid values: android and iphoneos.
author String: The user who initiated or operated the task.
sessionId String: The device session ID.
userName String: The user nickname or custom username.
deviceId String: The unique identifier of the device.
geo String: The geographic information of the device.
taskType String: The task type. For remote log scenarios, this is typically REMOTE_LOG.
modifyTime Long: The last update time of the collection record, in UNIX millisecond timestamp.
expireTime Long: The expiration time of the collection result, in UNIX millisecond timestamp.
osVersion String: The operating system version number.
sourceType String: The task source type, such as USER, which indicates a log retrieval task initiated from the console.
createTime Long: The creation time of the collection record, in UNIX millisecond timestamp.
fileSize Long: The size of the collected log file or result. The specific unit is defined by the server.
requestId String: The request ID of a single collection, used to trace the execution path of the collection record.
appId String: The application identifier, typically in the format of `<appKey>@<os>`.
dayNum Integer: The number of days for log retrieval.
appKey String: The application AppKey.
deviceModel String: The device model.
id String: The collection record ID.
brand String: The device brand.
taskId String: The remote log task ID, used to associate with the parent task.
status String: The current status of the collection record, such as FINISHED
Model.description_zh:
Model Object 接口返回的业务数据对象
Model.collectionNums Long 当前任务下的采集记录总数
Model.collectionsList Array 按采集状态分组后的采集结果列表
Model.collectionsList[].name String 采集状态分组名称，通常与采集记录的 status 对应，例如 FINISHED
Model.collectionsList[].list Array 当前状态分组下的采集记录列表

`Model.collectionsList[].list[]` 字段说明：

reason Object 任务发起原因信息
reason.description String 发起原因描述，例如按发起时间计算最近几天的日志
reason.type String 发起原因类型，例如 USER 表示用户主动发起
appVersion String 应用版本号
os String 设备系统类型，约定值为 android 或 iphoneos
author String 任务发起人或操作人
sessionId String 设备会话 ID
userName String 用户昵称或自定义用户名
deviceId String 设备唯一标识
geo String 设备地域信息
taskType String 任务类型，远程日志场景通常为 REMOTE_LOG
modifyTime Long 采集记录最后更新时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
expireTime Long 采集结果过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
osVersion String 操作系统版本号
sourceType String 任务来源类型，例如 USER 表示控制台用户发起的回捞任务
createTime Long 采集记录创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
fileSize Long 采集到的日志文件大小或结果大小字段，具体单位以服务端定义为准
requestId String 单次采集请求 ID，用于定位该采集记录的执行链路
appId String 应用标识，通常格式为 `<appKey>@<os>`
dayNum Integer 回捞日志天数
appKey String 应用 AppKey
deviceModel String 设备型号
id String 采集记录 ID
brand String 设备品牌
taskId String 远程日志任务 ID，用于关联所属任务
status String 当前采集记录状态，例如 FINISHED
